subject: RE: Detention charge on load 7731-22
text:
Hi Marcus,

I checked with dispatch. The driver's ELD shows arrival at your Columbus dock at 7:52 AM for an 8:00 AM appointment and departure at 11:40 AM, so the 3 hours 40 minutes on site minus 2 hours free time gives 1 hour 40 minutes of detention, billed at $75 per hour rounded up to the half hour, which is $150.00 on invoice CF-21610.

If your receiving logs show something different, send them over and I'm happy to take another look.

Jasmine
